headline: 🏠 **9:45 THIS MORNING AT 355 COMANCHE — the only appointment on your whole board today, and it is the second brand-new brokerage in that house inside twenty-four hours.** Cheryl P. of Keller Williams Metro South has never shown it; Katie G. of Keller Williams Realty Hoover walked it yesterday afternoon, also her first time, and has filed nothing yet. ⭐ THAT MAKES THIS MORNING A REASON TO RING BOTH — *“we've got another showing at 9:45, anything I should know?”* is a question, not a chase, and it collects two reads for the price of one call. 🔍 **TWO FRESH GAPS ARE THE REAL WORK OF THE WEEKEND:** yesterday's tours at 355 Comanche and at the coastal condo both ran and neither has produced a word — seventeen and nineteen hours respectively, which is exactly the age at which a nudge still reads as interest rather than pressure. 🗣️ **NO NEW FEEDBACK LANDED OVERNIGHT.** The $1.15M read from yesterday afternoon is still the newest thing on this board, and the seller living in that house still has not heard it.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 **THE FOURTH PARTY WALKED THIS HOUSE AT 2:30 YESTERDAY AND HAS SAID NOTHING SINCE.** Davis H. of ARC Realty–Hoover booked at 11:08 that morning — his first showing of this address, the fifth tour on the house overall, and it landed two minutes after the milestone engine's window closed. ⭐ **THE REPEAT MATTERS:** this is the same agent whose buyers wrote on 355 Comanche in July. He is not a browser. ⚠️ **AND IT ARRIVED ON A HOUSE THAT ALREADY HOLDS A SIGNED OFFER**, which is precisely the moment a second interested party is worth the most and costs the least to ask.
hotSignals.action: 📞 **CALL HIM THIS MORNING** — you were in a listing appointment when he walked it and the window has now passed twice. Ask the price question straight and let him raise the two cosmetic items himself; every party who has toured has mentioned them and not one has argued the number. ⚠️ Do not mention the offer until the Angela question is ruled — that is the same open call applied to a new name.

hotSignals.signal: 📥 **OFFER IN HAND, BUYER SIGNED BEFORE THE SELLER EVER SAW IT — AND THIRTY HOURS LATER THE AGENT WHO SENT IT HAS STILL NOT HEARD BACK.** Molly G. of Keller Williams Hoover emailed the full packet at 2:20:39 PM Tuesday — purchase agreement with the buyer's signature on it, personal-property addendum, FHA addendum and a lender pre-approval — then texted ninety seconds later to be sure it was seen, and wrote *“Let me know that you have received.”* 🔴 THE REPLY HAS NOW SAT IN DRAFTS TWELVE HOURS AND IS STILL NOT SAFE TO SEND AS WRITTEN: it acknowledges the packet without correcting the flood figure. 🎯 The offered price is NOT known to this board and was not guessed: it lives inside the PDF and no lane here can open an attachment.
hotSignals.action: Add the flood correction to the draft first, then send it — and put a voice call ahead of it. Open the PDF and read the actual price before you talk numbers with anyone.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 **A THIRD AGENT CAME BACK ON HER OWN AND STILL DOES NOT KNOW AN OFFER EXISTS.** Angela W. of ARC Realty 280 — whose buyer toured Sunday and left in under ten minutes — wrote unprompted at 5:51 Tuesday morning calling it *“an adorable townhouse”* and said her buyer is forwarding the listing to a husband who works out of town. ⭐ THAT READ AS CLUTTER ON SUNDAY AND IT IS LEVERAGE TODAY: the offer in hand is FHA with a pre-approval written to exactly list price, which leaves zero headroom if the appraisal lands short. ⚠️ Two days on and nobody has told her.
hotSignals.action: **Day four and still unruled.** Call her and tell her an offer is in hand, with a same-day window for her buyer. ⚠️ One leg of the original argument is gone — the ad expiring was supposed to kill backup traffic, and a fresh organic tour arrived anyway — but the asymmetry still decides it: you can work the first offer clean after asking, and you cannot un-ask once it is under contract.

hotSignals.signal: 🎉 **THE FIRST FEEDBACK THIS ADDRESS EVER PRODUCED, AND THE HEADLINE WAS WHAT SHE DIDN'T SAY.** Anna C. of A2 Properties toured and filed a form that never challenged the price — across four tours and three brokerages, not one agent has argued the number. 🔍 That is what a correctly priced listing looks like once the marketing finds the buyers.
hotSignals.action: Nothing owed — Gene answered her himself and her reply is already in the thread. Carried as the pricing receipt behind today's negotiation.

hotSignals.signal: 🎯 **A FIFTH SHOWING SATURDAY AT 3:00 PM FROM AN AGENT WHO HAD NEVER SHOWN THIS HOUSE BEFORE — and the read has still not come back, five days on.** ⚠️ Separately, four independent agents have now filed the same verdict on this address: not interested, priced too high. The most recent added the worst staging score on this board and a lever that is not a price cut — a pre-inspection, because unknowns are exactly what one removes.
hotSignals.action: Chase Saturday's read once more, then stop chasing it — this address returns forms about half the time. The live buyer who put a specific number under the ask in writing is the one still uncalled, and he is now competing with a fresh booking.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 **THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS NOW DAY THIRTEEN.** Amy G. of Ethos International filed it herself: interested YES, her buyers just started looking, they really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list. She phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so a call back is returned, not cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED RIGHT BLANK — the objection is unasked, not absent, and only a person can ask it.
hotSignals.action: 📞 **HUMAN CALL, TODAY** — thirteen days is well past the window where a machine outreach is appropriate. 🎉 **AND YOU NOW HAVE A REASON THAT IS NOT CHASING:** the house is toured again tomorrow at 9:45, the first forward traffic in nearly two weeks. ⚠️ She left priced-right blank — the objection is unasked, not absent — and the basement lights she reported still have no answer from the seller.

upcoming: 🔥 **TODAY — SAT 8/29, 9:45 AM — 355 COMANCHE ST, MONTEVALLO. The only appointment on the board this weekend.** Cheryl P. of Keller Williams Metro South, confirmed 8/27 10:06a — **her first showing of this house**, and the SECOND brand-new brokerage inside twenty-four hours. ⭐ That takes the listing to twenty tours lifetime after nearly two weeks of nothing. 🎯 It also hands you a natural, non-chasing reason to ring Katie G. about yesterday's 2:30 and Amy G. about the interested-YES that is now fourteen days old.

📅 **TOMORROW — SUN 8/30 — 833 MADISON LN GOES LIVE.** ⭐ Willow Point proved exactly what the gap between photos-ready and booked costs: three days of paid ads before anyone toured it, then five bookings and a buyer-signed offer inside eleven days once the market found it. 🎉 PUBLISHING CAME BACK ONLINE OVERNIGHT after four days locked out — so unlike yesterday, the machine can actually carry this one. Today is the last day to pre-book it.

🎉 **SAT 9/12 9:00 AM — 2368 RIDGE TRAIL, and again SUN 9/13 9:00 AM.** Joey C. of EXIT Coosa River Realty, who has never shown this house. ⭐ Two consecutive mornings reserved two weeks out, booked 8/26 — on a listing that has taken forty-five showings without an offer. Traffic was never this file's problem.
